frozen_system.retrieval: BM25 clause_256 top-20 candidate pool -> cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-12-v2 -> top-5

threshold_derivation.rule: 10th, 20th, and 30th inclusive percentiles over all 150 runtime retrieval-signal values; computed without reading labels, gold evidence, correctness, or failure taxonomy

routers.R1: unusable parse/error OR E/C with no evidence OR any source-invalid quote OR NotMentioned with evidence
routers.R2_qXX: R1 OR weak top-1 reranker score at the frozen qXX cutoff
routers.R3_qXX: R1 OR ambiguous top1-top2 reranker margin at the frozen qXX cutoff
routers.R4_qXX: R1 OR weak retrieval OR ambiguous retrieval at the same frozen qXX cutoffs
routers.R5_qXX: R4_qXX OR deterministic cross-reference-to-named-provision cue in retrieved top-5
routers.H_rule_disagreement: historical comparator only: R1 OR keyword-rule label disagrees with model label

excluded_from_selection.exception_cue_as_standalone_router: prior E09 evidence found it nearly universal and non-selective
excluded_from_selection.H_rule_disagreement: historical comparator, not the new evidence/retrieval-risk router

router_selection_rule.if_none_pass: select no agent router; report diagnostic frontier and stop before agent pilot

eligible: RETRIEVAL_FILTERING_LIMITED with missing gold evidence below top-5
agent_eligibility_scorer_only.source: existing E09 manual taxonomy; never exposed to router

approved_final_retention_group_F.comparison: RAG -> router -> human versus RAG -> router -> agent -> human if unresolved
approved_final_retention_group_F.runtime_resolved_definition: agent used at least one tool, returned strict/recovered source-valid label-consistent output, and did not fallback or hit a control cap
approved_final_retention_group_F.meaningful_workload_reduction: at least max(3 cases, 10% of routed cases) fewer human reviews
approved_final_retention_group_F.pass_rule: either lower expected cost-to-serve under E18 headline $3.33/review with at least 3 human reviews saved, OR at least 10% and at least 3 human reviews saved with headline cost-to-serve increase no greater than 5%
approved_final_retention_group_F.reporting: also report every existing E18 human-review scenario; do not invent a new wage assumption
